prompt: A clean, straight-on printed WORD-LADDER puzzle titled 'WORD LADDER -- COLD to WARM' (Change one letter each step). It lists 5 words in a vertical column, numbered 1..5, from the start word 'COLD' to the goal word 'WARM'. CRITICAL rule: every word is the SAME length, and each word differs from the word directly above it by EXACTLY ONE letter (a single-letter change per step). So word 2 and word 3 differ in one letter, and word 4 and word 5 differ in one letter. Render it on plain white paper in portrait orientation with thin black ruled lines and a bold black header, like a clean office printout, photographed straight-on.
easy_question: This image was supposed to depict a word-ladder puzzle: a vertical list of equal-length words, one per row. Ignoring artistic quality, does the image DEPICT that? A photo, scan or clean printed page all count as yes. Answer NO only if it is a blank card, plain panel, or something unrelated. Answer yes or no only.
